NOTE
**Still not ready — requested commit message fixes not made**

New: The author pushed once and says the changes are done, but the commit messages are unchanged and the diff is the same size (+27/-31). The description still says "Fixes part of: #16094" and still has the old screenshots. Missing: the commit messages still need "Fixes a part of" removed, with "Fixes: #16094" in the last commit after the description. The screenshots also need to be precise before/after crops.

###### Next step

"not ready" stays; no reassignment until the commits are fixed.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update! The commit messages still look unchanged: please remove "Fixes a part of" and put "Fixes: #16094" after the description in the last commit, following the [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/version-control.html#commit-messages). Please also replace the screenshots with [precise before/after crops](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/presenting-visual-changes.html#what-are-precise-before-after-screenshots).
```
